name: supermarket-app
description: Supermarket e-commerce platform — Arabic RTL first

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:mobile-https: concurrently -n backend,frontend,https-proxy -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "node scripts/mobile-https-proxy.mjs"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
